issues_confirmed: build.sh:7 calls `zip`, which is not installed on this machine — `which zip` exits 1 and python's shutil.which() returns None for both `zip` and `7z`. With `set -euo pipefail` (build.sh:2) the script aborts there, so no .mcaddon has ever been produced. The 3a68778 commit message states the author never executed it.

resource_pack/attachables/scythe.json:11 points the held model's `default` texture at textures/items/iron_scythe (the 16x16 item icon). Decoded alpha shows the blade cube's box-UV window (scythe.geo.json:22-27, uv [0,0], size [2,8,2] -> u 0-8, v 0-10) is 9/80 pixels opaque (11%); the handle cube's window (scythe.geo.json:34-40, uv [8,0], size [1,8,1] -> u 8-12, v 0-9) is 18/36 but samples blade-steel pixels, not handle pixels. Under entity_alphatest (line 7) the held item renders near-invisible.

resource_pack/models/entity/scythe.geo.json:22-40 is two stacked boxes — a 1x8x1 handle (y 0-8) with a 2x8x2 cube directly above it (y 8-16). There is no blade curve or cross-piece; the geometry is not scythe-shaped even with a correct texture.

resource_pack/textures/items/iron_scythe.png: the blade and the handle share no edge. Column 8 alpha for rows 0-9 is [255,255,255,0,0,255,255,255,255,255] — rows 3 and 4 are empty, and the nearest blade pixel to the rivet at (5,8) is (2,8), three rows up. The blade floats in the hotbar. (64/256 pixels opaque overall; valid 16x16 8-bit RGBA.)
resource_pack/animations/scythe.animation.json:7-11 is a single static pose (rotation [0,0,-45], position [4,-4,0], loop: true) with no keyframes and no first/third-person split.
behavior_pack/loot_tables/items/scythe.json is an orphan — grep for `loot_table` across the repo returns only README.md:30, a directory listing. Neither manifest nor any pack file references it.

resource_pack/texts/en_US.lang:1 defines item.scythe:iron_scythe.name, but behavior_pack/items/scythe.json:38-40 hardcodes the literal "Iron Scythe" in minecraft:display_name.value, so the lang file is never read.

resource_pack/items/scythe.json:2,6 declares format_version "1.21.0" while using the retired description.category field, and duplicates only the identifier and icon that behavior_pack/items/scythe.json:5,17-19 already owns.
TESTING_IPAD.md:13 instructs the reader to download scythe_addon.mcaddon from the repo, but .gitignore:11 excludes *.mcaddon and no GitHub release exists.
TESTING_IPAD.md:97 and :102 describe the texture as a grey silhouette/grey shape — false since 2560df4.
README.md:59 still lists `- [ ] Add iron_scythe.png texture (16x16)` as open; it was completed in 2560df4.
behavior_pack/pack_icon.png and resource_pack/pack_icon.png are byte-identical (md5 60a910e7077915701565e6275fd27e9c), so the two packs are indistinguishable in the pack list.

verdict: Three small fixes from genuinely finished, but stalled — the gate has now been closed for a month across three reviews. The weapon itself is correctly defined and the icon is real; what's missing is a working packaging step (one line) and the deletion of a broken 3D-model chain the project doesn't need. The 2026-10-17 'fix' for the gate shipped a script depending on a binary that isn't installed and was never executed, so the add-on has still never been loaded in Minecraft. Highest-value move is task 1 plus one actual iPad run. Do not start the parked Script API ideas before that.
